title: Chapter 1479 - 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale) (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1479 - 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale) (Part 2)

Chapter 1479: Chapter 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale) (Part 2)

"Hm?"

At a certain moment, Lin Yuan felt a subtle movement in his heart.

A call from the past, a summon, vaguely established a connection with him.

Lin Yuan’s right foot, which was about to step onto the next step, paused slightly.

"Is it that time?"

Lin Yuan suddenly realized, at this moment, it was his past self, forced by the Blood Sea Lord while exploring the Wanwei space-time, hundreds of millions of years ago, that contacted him.

Swish!

Lin Yuan casually waved his sleeve.

An invisible aura crossed space-time, sweeping towards the past against the timeline.

Immediately, the past and future of the Blood Sea Lord completely collapsed and vanished.

After all this, Lin Yuan continued to climb, ascending step by step.

The pressure from the Blood Sea Lord, for Lin Yuan at that time, was unimaginably immense.

After all, he was a Legendary Lord.

But now?

Five million years ago, someone like the Blood Sea Lord was not even qualified to appear before Lin Yuan.

Let alone now.

After five million years of climbing, Lin Yuan’s strength is thousands or even tens of thousands of times greater than five million years ago.

"Still cannot transcend..."

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself, now feeling like he could withstand the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

That is to say, even if the Supreme Rule Dao itself took action, it couldn’t erase him.

"Keep climbing."

Lin Yuan didn’t dwell on it, paused for a moment, then stepped onto the next step again.

Time began to flow rapidly again.

Tens of millions of years.

Hundreds of millions of years.

Billions of years.

An epoch of great destruction.

Ten epochs of great destruction.

A hundred epochs of great destruction.

...

This is the highest point in terms of spatial significance and the original source in terms of time significance.

A magnificent and towering gate of light stood there, its existence silently influencing multiple timelines, numerous dimensional spaces, Dimension Heaven and Earth, and countless beings.

And at the threshold of the gate of light leaned a blurred figure.

The blurred figure’s face was indistinct, seemingly with eyes closed, as if asleep.

It appeared to lean beneath the towering and magnificent gate of light, yet the aura it subtly emitted was above the gate of light, with the slightest breath sweeping through countless timelines, birthing the universe, all dimensions, and infinite dimensional worlds.

Whoosh—The blurred figure leaning against the gate of light moved slightly, eyes slowly opening.

At this moment, the figure was no longer blurred, everything became clear, it looked identical to Lin Yuan, but much stronger, much deeper, and the strand of aura it casually emitted far exceeded the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

"This cycle of reincarnation ended so quickly?"

Lin Yuan stood up, standing beneath the gates of endless dimensions and grand light, looking down.

A never-ending staircase of white jade led to this place, while the starting end descended into infinite dimensional worlds.

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept through the infinite dimensional worlds, capturing not only the spatial but also the temporal aspects, observing everything from the beginning of these worlds to the present without any concealment or cover.

"This is the 33,333rd cycle of reincarnation, the previous 33,332 cycles ended only after experiencing an entire era, but this one ended so early, indicating that my accumulation must be full."

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

The infinite dimensional worlds, created by Lin Yuan, served to walk different paths, enhance accumulation and own foundation, to step into higher levels.

Typically, the time for a cycle of reincarnation would not exceed the lifespan of the infinite dimensional worlds from birth to destruction.

In past cycles, Lin Yuan would awaken only after experiencing a complete era of reincarnation, and all the experiences and paths of that era would convert into accumulation and foundation.

And now, it took only a few hundred epochs of great destruction?

A few hundred epochs of great destruction, compared to a complete reincarnation era, was merely akin to a nap.

"In each reincarnation, I would abandon all methods, even my memories were sealed, leaving only a projection of the ’Myriad Realms Gate’ accompanying me, but to enhance the sense of pressure, even the projection of the Myriad Realms Gate had no offensive means, as I took away all real combat capabilities."

Lin Yuan’s expression showed a hint of emotion, the Myriad Realms Gate being his crafted vital weapon, where its projection’s main purpose was to guide Lin Yuan’s reincarnated self through various dimensional spaces, and most importantly, through the 33 Origin Worlds.

These 33 Origin Worlds weren’t as simple as they appeared superficially, crafted with immense effort by Lin Yuan for his reincarnated self.

In the past 33,332 cycles of reincarnation, Lin Yuan had not grasped the mysteries of the 33 Origin Worlds; however, in this 33,333rd cycle, by merely exploring over a dozen Origin Worlds, the cycle ended, signifying that he completely comprehended the essence of the 33 Origin Worlds.

Just like a bucket, if not full, the overflowing water won’t spill out.

Only when it is full will there be an overflow.

This cycle ended so fast for Lin Yuan, signifying that the accumulation was complete, with no further need for cycles.

"Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao? Innate Five Great? Chaos Innate Five Great Fusion Dao?" Lin Yuan felt the harvest of this cycle, a smile appearing on his face: "No wonder it ended so fast, the path realized has entirely complemented the path I’ve been walking."

"Infinite Dimensional Worlds..."

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept through the infinite dimensional worlds, over the 33,333 cycles of reincarnation, each cycle’s experiences were generally identical.
